items.description: Recovery of stolen bicycle incl. locksmith call-out and cutting of seized lock (3 pcs)
items.rationale: Recovery cost under 5.2.2(a),(b),(d), but the bike is unscheduled mobility equipment, so the EUR 500 aggregate sub-limit (4.2.2) covers recovery and repair together. Assumed fair price about EUR 350 of about EUR 1,250 total claim, so rateable share is about EUR 145.

items.description: Repair of theft damage to bicycle, frame and brakes (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Damage found on a recovered item is made good under 2.3.1(b) and 7.1.1(b), within the same EUR 500 class sub-limit (4.2.2, 7.1.10). Assumed fair price about EUR 700 of about EUR 1,250 total, so rateable share is about EUR 275.

Labour and sundries share the fate of the covered recovery and repair work (7.1.7(d),(e), 5.2.2(b)), so they are indemnifiable but share the EUR 500 sub-limit rateably. Assumed fair price about EUR 200 of about EUR 1,250 total, so rateable share is about EUR 80.
